segments.name: data center
segments.description: Owns and operates data centres leased to cloud, enterprise and network customers.
segments.evidence: In order to best accommodate the needs of global customers (and customers that might one day become global), the Company manages its operations as a single global business – with one operating segment and therefore one reporting segment.

revenueModel.text: Cloud providers, enterprises and network operators pay rent for data centre space and power.
revenueModel.evidence: Our Business We provide a global data center platform that supports our customers' digital infrastructure and enables our customers to interconnect with their customers and partners.
